prompt:
Production sprite-family sheet for a premium portrait fantasy brick-breaker. Use first two reference images for the SAME emerald snake identity, right-facing camera and head shape; the final two references demonstrate required dimensional rendered MATERIAL/lighting quality only, NOT their armour or props. Redesign the simple old head into a polished expressive emerald viper matching those rich fantasy renders. No costume, hat, armour, castle, horns or accessories.
ONE coherent snake-head family with TEN complete right-facing head/short-neck busts in an exact TWO COLUMN by FIVE ROW grid on true transparent RGBA. Large empty transparent gutters, each complete head contained within its own cell with at least15%margin; no text, labels, grid lines, shadows, background, UI or other objects. Landscape head within each cell. The image canvas is portrait; rows and columns evenly spaced.
IDENTITY LOCK: low broad rounded wedge skull and short snout, jade/emerald green dorsal scales matching #168f83, deeper #0b5d59 crown and #052d31 neck shadow, pale mint/ivory #c9e8d2 lower jaw and belly seam, tiny mint diamond scale highlights, two large readable amber-green irises with vertical dark pupils, warm coral-pink brow ridge (subtle, flesh-like, no pasted eyebrows). Fine bevelled overlapping scales with larger simple planes on forehead, physically based glossy roughness variation, broad soft studio highlights from upper left, shaded lower planes, subtle skin depth and clean smooth silhouette. Same light/camera/proportions/size for every head. Not photoreal snake, not flat vector; a dimensional feature-animation creature render. Face must remain readable at32worldunits/35phonepixels.
CAMERA: side/front three-quarter matching the first source, nose points to the RIGHT, far eye visible above nearer eye, head horizontal. Closed-mouth base is broad rather than long-necked. Neck connection is short at left-rear and ends softly rounded, no long body or isolated ball. Both eyes, snout, rear skull and jaw fully inside every cell.
ROW1 LEFT idle: alert relaxed closed mouth, bright watchful eyes and raised inner brows; ROW1 RIGHT blink: same exact head/volume, eyelids fully closed in a gentle blink, mouth closed.
ROW2 LEFT taste: same alert head, lips slightly parted and a small thin forked pink tongue extending right (fully inside margin); ROW2 RIGHT hunt: determined predatory focus, narrowed lids, brows pulled down, mouth closed with restrained tooth line.
ROW3 LEFT chew-open: jaw opened moderately, soft cheeks/neck bulging naturally, pink interior visible, eyes concentrating, no prey/object; ROW3 RIGHT chew-closed: mouth shut, jaw/cheek mass compressed upwards and cheeks slightly full, eyes half-squinting, no object.
ROW4 LEFT hiss: fierce wide open jaw with TWO proportionate ivory upper fangs and clean pink mouth interior, broad stretched lower jaw, angry brows and forward stare, no liquid/breath; ROW4 RIGHT hurt: one eye squeezed shut, other eye startled, brows asymmetrical, mouth winces open slightly, head recoils a little while rear skull remains aligned; no wounds or symbols.
ROW5 LEFT dizzy: dazed uneven half-lidded eyes, pupils visibly off-centre and mismatched gaze, slack small open mouth, no stars/spirals/crosses/symbols; ROW5 RIGHT grin: mischievous victorious smile with relaxed brow and lifted mouth corner, small tooth line, open bright eyes.
Every face is a genuine mouth/eyelid/brow pose, not ten unchanged heads. Keep exact species, camera, scale, colour/lighting and rear-neck registration coherent across rows. No white background, no black matte, no drop shadows.
